vat.name: Value Added Tax
vat.statute: VAT Act 2012 (rate as stated by the GRA leaflet: 15 %; official secondary) [text version: GRA brochures as published on gra.gm on 21 August 2023 (the corporation-tax brochure dates its rate to 2018); Finance Acts 2024 and 2025 not held (flag)]
vat.doc: GRA leaflet: "The standard VAT rate is 15 percent … applied to all goods and services unless they are specifically" exempt; "Basic foods such as rice, sugar, flour, cooking oil, onions, potatoes, etc" are exempt (food line taxed at 15 % here). Source flagged official secondary.
notes: Gambia: VAT rate from the GRA leaflet (official secondary); exempt basic foods inside the food line

cit.name: Corporation income tax
cit.statute: Income and Value Added Tax Act 2012 (as amended; rate as stated by the GRA brochure 'Corporation Income Tax'): the higher of 27 % of net profit and 1 % of turnover (audited accounts; 2 % unaudited) [text version: GRA brochures as published on gra.gm on 21 August 2023 (the corporation-tax brochure dates its rate to 2018); Finance Acts 2024 and 2025 not held (flag)]
cit.doc: GRA brochure 'Corporation Income Tax' (published 21 Aug 2023): "3. What is the Corporation Tax Rate? The Corporation tax rate is the higher of: • 27% of net profit (2018) or • 1% of turnover on audited accounts (2% of turnover for unaudited accounts)." Worked example: "if X & Co. Ltd.'s turnover in 2018 is D5 million and the company's net profit is D1.5 million, then the company's tax liability ... will be D405,000"; "Losses carried forward within six years".
notes: official secondary source: the brochure states the rate 'as of 2018' and is still the authority's published guide; Finance Acts 2019-2025 were not read (flagged)
companies are taken to have audited accounts (1 % turnover minimum); the 2 % unaudited minimum and the six-year loss limit are not modelled
unsupported: Act and Finance Acts 2019-2025 not read

wht.name: Withholding tax on payments to non-residents
wht.statute: Income and Value Added Tax Act 2012 (as stated by the GRA brochures 'Withholding Tax' and 'Dividend Income Tax'): payments to non-resident contractors, suppliers or service providers 10 % (final); dividends 15 % on payments to resident and non-resident shareholders [text version: GRA brochures as published on gra.gm on 21 August 2023 (the corporation-tax brochure dates its rate to 2018); Finance Acts 2024 and 2025 not held (flag)]
wht.doc: GRA brochure 'Withholding Tax on Contract Payments': "The following are the types of withholding tax; • 10% for payments to non-resident Contractors, Suppliers or Service Providers ..."; "9. Is the Payments Made a Final Tax? For non-resident contractors and subcontractors, the tax withheld is a final tax." GRA brochure 'Dividend Income Tax': "All resident companies or partnerships are liable to withheld dividend income tax on all dividend payments to resident and non-resident shareholders or partners. ... The dividend income tax rate is 15% of the gross amount of dividend paid."

rules.statute: GRA 'Withholding Tax' brochure: non-resident contractors, suppliers or service providers 10 % (final)
GRA 'Dividend Income Tax' brochure: 15 % of the gross dividend

notes: interest and royalties paid abroad are not covered by the brochures held (not modelled)
official secondary source; the Act's withholding schedule was not read
unsupported: interest and royalties paid to non-residents
